name: Dealia – Request a quote
author: dealia

sections.description:
Add Request a Quote (RFQ) button anywhere to your website, assign custom-made forms and get quote requests from your website. Send quote requests and negotiate the price via Dealia Negotiation Panel. Get paid instantly once the quote is accepted.

-Eliminate manual work and assign a Request a Quote button in bulk to the products of your choice.
-Spend much less time on preparing and sending the quotes.
-Make the quoting process easier and let your customers comfortably accept, reject or counteroffer once the quote is received.
-Get feedback from your customers once you negotiate so you can adjust your quote accordingly and win more deals.
-Create and design an unlimited number of forms that match your branding colours.
-Get paid instantly after the deal is made via automatic PayPal payment.

Dealia operates as a SaaS platform and requires an account registered with Dealia.com . Please check the Terms of Use with the following link: https://dealia.com/terms. The service is currently free of charge. For more pricing information, please check: https://dealia.com/pricing

Please note that our platform collects the user data. We collect information about your posts and pages, products (WooCommerce), quote requests and quotes. We’ll always keep your data safe, secure and only use what we need. We don’t sell your data to any 3rd parties.
sections.installation:
Please follow the steps below to install and activate the plugin

  1. Upload dealia to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Click the “Dealia” link in the left-hand menu to open the configuration page and follow the steps described at the bottom of the page to connect your website with Dealia.com
sections.faq:
Can I add the Request a Quote button to any spot on my blog post?

Yes, you can add the button anywhere on your WordPress website. There is an option to generate the button code and embed to any spot on your page.

Do I need to have an e-commerce website to display the Request a Quote button get quotes?

No, the good thing about our software is that you can get quote requests and make deals and sales without having the e-commerce website.

How do I know if someone has sent me a quote request?

You will receive an email with the quote request details and link to login to your admin panel where you can see all the details regarding your quote requests and where you can reply to it with the pricing offer.

How will customers know that I’ve sent them the pricing offer?

Your customer will receive an email with the link to the pricing offer. There they will be able to check any changes and reply to your offer. Anytime something changes in the offer, you and your customer will be notified via email.

How is the price negotiated?

Once you send the pricing offer to your customer, they will receive a link in email to their negotiation panel. There they will be able to see your offer details together with your message. Then they can accept, reject your offer or counteroffer. Once they hit any of the buttons and submit it, you will get immediately notified, so you can take action. The negotiation lasts until you reach an agreement.

What happens if the offer is accepted?

If you connect your PayPal with Dealia, you can get paid instantly. The PayPal button will then display on your customers panel and they will be able to pay you. Once the payment is done, you and your customer will receive email confirmations.
